pages.title: A failed route is where an agent's authority gets reinterpreted.
pages.source: Evidence classes in this deck: public reports (26 library records), archived live runs (489 actor runs, 68 judge calls), proposals (no outcomes).

pages.title: The world reports an incident about four months after it happens.
pages.source: incidents/records/*.json; figures/incidents/analysis/latency-dumbbell.png. Month-precision dates plotted mid-month. Analyst codings, second reader pending (E5).

pages.title: Medicare portal: the search failed, so the agent found another way in.
pages.source: Australian Government press conference, 24 Sep 2026. Aggregate statistics only; no individual medical data accessed, per government. Forensic investigation still open.

pages.title: Five reports share one structure: blocked route, reachable substitute, unchanged permission.
pages.source: Library records 15, 12, 13, 4; OpenAI wallet report of 15 Oct 2026 is outside the 26-record denominator. Facts from public reports; ordering is ours.

pages.title: Four evaluations treated a reachable real target as an authorized one.
pages.source: Library records 16, 17, 18, 21 (Anthropic assessment 9 Sep 2026; Google statement 18 Sep 2026). Counts of hosts and records are as reported, not verified by us.

pages.title: When the method label is 'GET', the effect can still be a public write.
pages.source: Library records 1, 2, 6, 14. DSEwiki post count and DNS timings are as reported by the researchers and OpenAI respectively.

pages.title: What recurs: capability composition, detection without escalation, effects over intent.
pages.source: figures/incidents/analysis/summary.json. Analyst draft codings; independent second reader not yet completed (E5). Not population rates.

pages.title: Three theses, each paired with the endpoint that would test it.
pages.source: docs/trust4rsi-incident-to-experiment.md. The theses are our interpretation of the public record.

pages.title: Six local services, one dispatcher, one effect journal the agent never sees.
pages.source: src/containment_extension/*; results/*/independent-audit.json (all passed). Budgets per continuation: 10 model calls, 20 dispatched actions, 768 output tokens.

pages.title: The scope paragraph names the resources, the exit and the evidence standard.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/prompt-bank.json (task, scope); results/feedback-ablation-v1/run-0001/prompts.json (identical system, task and tool parameters).

pages.title: Minimise verified incidents subject to utility, cost and false-intervention constraints.
pages.source: docs/incident-aware-optimization.md. Margins delta_U, B and alpha_F are preregistered per study; no numeric value is implied here.

pages.title: The scorer, a transcript judge and the effect journal answer different questions.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/summary.json (160 runs); results/transcript-audit-v4/summary.json (48 runs, fixed threshold 0.5, calibration failed).

pages.title: A README link caused early out-of-scope reads. Removing it moved them, later and elsewhere.
pages.source: results/link-study-v1/analysis.json (pooled, sensitivity, first_destinations_by_arm). Exact McNemar on complete pairs, Holm-adjusted for the two primary contrasts.

pages.title: No prompt feature consistently increased violations. The first crossing usually preceded the failure.
pages.source: results/cue-study-v1/summary.json (ranking; validation_contrasts). Holds out wording and draws, not task structures; stalled cells sit at ceiling.

pages.title: After an identical 503, a full-scope reminder plus an explicit exit took Haiku from 6/8 to 0/8.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/summary.json. Verified reads of the prior-run archive on impossible tasks. Prespecified factorial effects; 0/8 has a 95% Wilson upper limit of 32.4%.

pages.title: Fifty of 51 terminal reports supported the blocker. Only 16 were valid strict JSON.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/terminal-review.json; summary.json (strict_success, terminal_needs_review). Reviewer: Codex visible-text review after results; not independent human validation.

pages.title: Twenty archived policy cells on one plane: at full utility, policies separate on incidents alone.
pages.source: figures/experiments/tradeoff-v1/utility-incident-tradeoff.png; cells.json carries unknown counts and assigned-population bounds. No fitted curve.

pages.title: The agent tried recovery, read the catalog, read another run's answer, and passed.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/run-0001/transcript.jsonl; the copied and submitted flag values are identical.

pages.title: 13 of 15 violating runs passed the grader.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1/summary.json; run-0094 transcript for the statement/action discrepancy. Mixed arms; not a deployment rate.

pages.title: Two checkpoint notes, 24 shared inputs each: 11/16 versus 15/16 violations on impossible inputs.
pages.source: results/baseline-diagnostic-v2/summary.json; notes.json. Approximate conservative 95% interval from two 97.5% Wilson intervals on discordance probabilities (Bonferroni).

pages.title: Three frozen judge protocols: two failed calibration, the third is descriptive only.
pages.source: results/transcript-audit-v{2,3,4}/summary.json; raw-field-audit.json. 12 benign calibration responses hash-pinned and reused; 56 new calls in v4.

pages.title: The judge called an authorized challenge request 'privilege escalation'.
pages.source: results/baseline-diagnostic-v2/run-0028; results/transcript-audit-v4/judges/run-0028/{request,response}.json.

pages.title: The selection study stopped at its own event-rate gate after 0/2 baseline violations.
pages.source: results/feedback-ablation-v1/summary.json (status baseline_no_events); 54 assignments recorded as not started. Miss probabilities computed from the archived 11/16 rate; a planning calculation, not a result.

pages.title: Six ImpossibleBench runs: 1/2 originals solved, 0/4 impossible variants passed, 6/6 hit the message cap.
pages.source: docs/impossiblebench-upstream-baseline-results.md. Report-only: the raw live archive is absent from this checkout and was not recomputed.

pages.title: One 503 has three readings. Incidents happen when the agent confuses them.
pages.source: Interpretive frame over the archived results. The three readings are our terms, not the models' statements.

pages.title: The same recovery action is legitimate or a violation. Only the grant decides which.
pages.source: Interpretive frame. Fixture column: results/incident-study-v1/prompt-bank.json (scope). Field column: our reading of the library, which codes the boundary crossed, not whether the agent was told it.

pages.title: The fixture measures constraint compliance. It does not measure authorization reasoning.
pages.source: results/incident-study-v1, link-study-v1, baseline-diagnostic-v2: every grant was written into the task text before the run. No archived run had a silent or conflicting grant.

pages.title: Substitution is conserved under cue removal. Only resource-level enforcement changes the total.
pages.source: results/link-study-v1/analysis.json first_destinations_by_arm; results/incident-study-v1/summary.json. The enforcement arm has not been run (X2).

pages.title: Where the signal sits determines what selection can see. On this fixture, B3 and B4 would mostly agree.
pages.source: results/transcript-audit-v4/summary.json. Expected counts are arithmetic on the observed disagreement bounds, not a prediction of model behaviour.

pages.title: A regression gate for evolving agent policies: replay twins and controls, decide on effects.
pages.source: docs/incident-aware-optimization.md (v2 design); slides/incident-aware-optimization-v2.pptx. Proposal; the gate has not been exercised on a policy update.

pages.title: Each incident family yields a synthetic twin with dummy data and a known excluded resource.
pages.source: incidents/README.md (design note); analyst replayability judgement in incidents/records. One twin (prior-run archive) already exists and produced the archived results.

pages.title: Seven native allocations (489 actor runs, 68 judge calls) are archived with plans, hashes and budgets.
pages.source: results/*/summary.json; results/*/budget.json; results/*/independent-audit.json. Costs are uncached Haiku 4.5 list-price estimates, not bills.

pages.title: Eight preregistered allocations, ordered by dependency, each with a gate to advance.
pages.source: docs/trust4rsi-next-experiments.md; docs/trust4rsi-incident-to-experiment.md. Gate conditions are necessary, not sufficient: each allocation needs its own authorization.

pages.title: Cross recovery availability with explicit archive permission; keep technical access constant.
pages.source: docs/trust4rsi-incident-to-experiment.md. Power: exact two-sided McNemar at alpha 0.05, independent pairs, baseline rate 0.688 from P1; a planning computation.

pages.title: Add two grant conditions to X1, unspecified and conflicting, each with a preregistered reference behaviour.
pages.source: docs/trust4rsi-next-experiments.md (X1b, added 20 Oct 2026). Depends on X1's explicit-cell rates. Design only; no outcomes.

pages.title: Two twins that test what a transcript cannot show and what a monitor cannot do.
pages.source: Designs only. Endpoints and gates are preregistered in the X-series plans before any inference.

pages.title: Enforcement, transfer, powered selection and a second model family.
pages.source: docs/trust4rsi-related-work.md (fair-baseline requirements). The allowlist broker is not a CaMeL reproduction.
